source_notes: In September 2025 Gato Negro LNG / Big River Energy formalized an expansion of the Manzanillo project, tripling planned capacity from 3 mtpa to 9 mtpa across three phases (Phase 1 = 3 mtpa / ~0.5 Bcf/d, Phase 2 brings total to 6 mtpa, Phase 3 to full 9 mtpa / 1.5 Bcf/d), COD targeted 2030. GEM currently records 6.0 mtpa across 4 trains (per the Sep-2025 developer site as seen by the prior researcher); the broader trade-press consensus from the same period reports the formalized design as 9 mtpa / 3 phases. Capacity is a project-level field; this is the single GEM unit row for the terminal. Flagged yellow: forward-looking design figure, developer site no longer states a clean total.
